newsitem.title: FRANCE: French Est Republicain paper buys Strasbourg daily.
newsitem.headline: French Est Republicain paper buys Strasbourg daily.

text.p: The French newspaper L'Est Republicain has bought control of the Strasbourg daily Les Dernieres Nouvelles d'Alsace after buying a stake held by Banque Vernes, sources at the newspaper's staff council said on Friday.

They said they were told on Friday morning that L'Est Republicain, which already controlled 30 percent of Dernieres Nouvelles, bought the bank's 50 percent stake in Multimedia Futur, the holding company which owns the remaining 70 percent.

Multimedia Futur was a joint venture between Banque Vernes and the France-Antilles regional newspapers subsidiary of the Hersant publishing group which is being restructured after the death of founder Robert Hersant. France-Antilles also controls 27 percent of L'Est Republicain.
L'Est Republicain, based in the eastern city of Nancy, now owns 65 percent of Les Dernieres Nouvelles d'Alsace.
The transaction sum was not disclosed, but industry sources estimated it at around 250 million francs ($43.5 million).

Les Dernieres Nouvelles d'Alsace, which has a circulation of 215,000, earned 20 million francs in 1996 on sales of 666 million. L'Est Republicain, with a circulation of 288,000, had 850 million francs in turnover last year.
"We were reassured that the new company would maintain all the jobs and agreements at Les Dernieres Nouvelles," the staff council secretary Daniel Trag told Reuters. ($ = 5.749 French Francs)
